mentions.name: Guitar Hero-style electric drum game
mentions.description: A Guitar Hero-style rhythm game played with a real electronic drum kit, started as a way for the author to teach himself drumming. The concept involved extracting drum information from real songs, which the author explored by designing a DSL.
mentions.source_excerpt: Maybe 10 years ago I started to build Guitar Hero style game with real electric drums, initially to teach myself drumming.
